title: Future price of an HDB resale flat
subject: flat
scope: What a 4-room HDB resale flat might cost in future years, if prices rise at a low, base or high yearly rate from today's median. A scenario tool, not a forecast.
limits: The three rates are assumptions around recent trends, not predictions. Resale prices can fall (they slipped for three quarters in 2026). The median is one town-mix average; your block will differ.

items.name: 4-room HDB resale flat
items.rateBasis: Assumed: flat prices (low), about long-run inflation plus a little (base), a strong run like 2025's (high). Prices are down 0.6% so far in 2026.
items.notes: 4-room median of S$628,000 in Q3 2026 per a price tracker; the HDB index fell 0.2% on the quarter (flash estimate). Final HDB figures may differ.

builtBy: Built by hand with Claude on 27 Oct 2026 to show this template. Figures come from a few web searches, not a full research run: check each source.
